|translation='''Title:''' Wes Janson.

'''Card text:'''
If aboard a starship as a passenger, add 1 to that starship's weapon destiny. If aboard Rogue 3 with Wedge or Jek, add 3 to weapon destiny.

'''Lore:'''
For years he served as a gunner with his friend Jek Porkins in the Tierfon Yellow Aces. His marksmanship brought the early Alliance several victories.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' English wiki text is Rogue 3 or with Wedge or Jek.
